eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maui, HI; at 6:17 PM on SEP 26, 2026 Effective until 10:17 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: MEMA Alert: A fast-moving brush fire is burning in the Olowalu Village area on Island. Repeat, A fast-moving brush fire is burning in the Olowalu Village area on Island. Evacuation order is in place for Olowalu Village. Follow direction from public safety personnel. Avoid the area. Sent by the Maui Emergency Management Agency (MEMA).
